The Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) is an open platform for sharing data across platforms and 
organizations. The goal of HDX is to make humanitarian data easy to find and use for analysis. Launched 
in July 2014, HDX has been accessed by millions of users in over 250 countries and territories and brings 
together more than 20,500 datasets from over 290 partner organizations.
 
 
The Humanitarian Exchange Language
A simple standard for messy data
The Humanitarian Exchange Language (HXL) is a data standard. It is based on spreadsheet formats such as 
CSV or Excel, but it adds hashtags with semantic information to allow sofware to validate, clean, merge 
and analyse data more easily.
